items.text:
I contacted V1 Window Cleaning to request a quote.
Very reasonable quote and booked in for a clean every month.
Tony arrived on Saturday and what a difference I now have sparkling clean windows.
I would highly recommended V1 to anyone.
items.author: Irene Carson
items.headline: Irene Carson recommends V1 Window Cleaning.

items.text: Tony came to do my windows today and what a pleasant experience. I could see he was taking his time to make sure my windows were gleaming! I’ve never seen them so clean!! The little touch that made it for me was when Tony saw my son come to the window so he sprayed the window for him. Not only are my windows perfect but you brought a smile to both our faces. You sir are a credit!
